{{Quote|I work for Jabba the Hutt. He's the major power here, no matter what the unimportant politicians around here say. He's a good benefactor to have on your side.|Alduq Besene, to a trader|<ref name="SWG:AAT" />}}
'''Alduq Besene''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked as an artisan for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] and was always looking for new talent.<ref name="SWG:AAT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to create a number of tools, to test the spacer's ability.<ref name="SWG:AAT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alduq Besene was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AAT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Alduq Besene was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]", on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He used to be a specialized trainer providing a quest to the beginner players who had chosen a career of "[[W:c:swg:Artisan|artisan]]."<ref name="SWG:AAT" /> The "artisan" profession was later replaced by the similar "[[W:c:swg:Trader|trader]]" profession with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SWG:2005" />
